_comment: An INVENTED sidecar for tutorial_look.py, in the exact shape its loader reads. Every value is made up: a fictional screen recording of a notes app with a webcam box. A real sidecar is written from frames of your own recording pulled with ffmpeg -nostdin, every box and time measured on them. It sits beside its spec as <spec id>-tutorial.json (here the spec would be specs/example/tutorial-1-T1.json); a -hook2 twin reads its base's sidecar. Keys ending in _note, label, what and why are for people and are never read by the code.
measured_on: an example: frames of tutorials/tutorial-1/screen.mp4 (1920x1080) pulled with ffmpeg -nostdin at 120, 122, 124, 127, 130, 133, 136, 140, 144, 148, 152, 156
face_region_note: the webcam is a rounded square x 1536..1896, y 696..1056 bottom right; inset 12 px so its rounded corners and the screen behind them stay out of the face search
bounds_note: the app's main column: the crop never shows the sidebar (x under 400) or the webcam box (x over 1520)

private.what: the system menu bar with the clock
the sidebar with the creator's own document titles
a local file path in the status line

private_masks.what: the toast, painted in the page's own background
the status line's path, on every frame

regions.label: the typed prompt, shown frozen at 129.0 (live, the composer is still empty here)
regions.block_note: the 4-line prompt he reads aloud: lines read from their first word, the view pans only as he reads past the visible line

regions.label: the 2 buttons: Keep both and Replace
the long generated text he says to skip
the one line that matters: the checklist count
regions.bounds_note: below the generated text: a crop never shows half a paragraph

regions.label: the whole note, wide, for the close

card.why: an example: the card restates his line in 4 words, and its arrow points at the mark with id 'count'

notes: 123.9 to 130.0 show the screen frozen at 129.0 (src_at): the prompt as typed, while he reads it aloud before he types it.
The toast at 131.0 to 135.5 is painted out in the page's own background; the status line's path is painted out on every frame.

layout_pick.why: an example: he reads a multi-line prompt aloud, and A keeps the page light and the card wide enough for the highlighter to follow each clause; C renders as the compare.

cap_note: capitals measured on the frames (ink rows of one capital letter): an example value per mark in cap_px, text_cap_px the default
